description.content: Retrieve time series data for BLS statistical series

Retrieve time series data for one or more BLS series IDs. Version 2 supports up to 50 series per request, date range filtering, optional calculations (net change, percent change), annual averages, and catalog descriptions. Requires a registered API key in the request body.
Retrieve time series data for a single BLS series ID using a GET request. This endpoint works with both v1 and v2. For v2, include the registration key as a query parameter for higher limits.

info.name: BLS Public Data Popular Series Time Series API

description.content:
The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Public Data API allows developers to retrieve published historical time series data from all BLS surveys. Version 2 requires a free API registration key and provides higher query limits: up to 500 daily queries, 50 series per request, and 20 years of data. The API covers Consumer Price Index (CPI), employment and unemployment statistics, wages, productivity, industry employment, and occupational statistics.
